summary: Industry report examining how public blockchains can support financial-market use cases, highlighting opportunities for tokenization and digital assets alongside governance, interoperability, and regulatory considerations needed for broader institutional adoption.

title: Public Blockchains and Regulated Financial Institutions: Key Challenges, Layered Solutions, and a Path Forward
summary: Analyzes the main barriers for regulated financial institutions using public blockchains, including front-running, censorship, unsolicited tokens, sanctions exposure through gas fees, privacy, and finality. Proposes layered solutions across application, network governance, and regulation.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/Industry/Real-World Tokenisation: Changer (Jun 2026).pdf
title: Real-World Tokenisation: Changer (Jun 2026)
summary: Analyzes how DLT-enabled trade finance and real-world asset tokenisation could transform global trade, positioning tokenised assets as a potential game changer. The report frames the topic as a comprehensive research and analysis piece.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/Industry/The Blueprint - DeFi Risk Stablecoins and the Future of Finance.pdf
title: The Blueprint - DeFi Risk Stablecoins and the Future of Finance
summary: Analyzes how DeFi and stablecoins are reshaping financial markets, emphasizing the risks they introduce and the regulatory and structural questions they raise for the future of finance.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/Industry/The Blueprint for Institutional Digital Assets Trading.pdf
title: The Blueprint for Institutional Digital Assets Trading
summary: Institutional demand for digital assets is rising, but OTC market structure built on bilateral, vertically integrated exchange models creates fragmented liquidity, counterparty risk and capital inefficiency. It argues Digital Prime Brokers should provide modular netting, credit intermediation and risk controls.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/Industry/The New Financial Order - RWAs and Stablecoins.pdf
title: The New Financial Order - RWAs and Stablecoins
summary: Analyzes how real-world asset tokenization and stablecoins are reshaping financial market structure by linking traditional assets with blockchain-based settlement and liquidity. Emphasizes their potential to improve efficiency, access, and interoperability across digital finance.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/Industry/The Next Frontier of Financial Markets.pdf
title: The Next Frontier of Financial Markets
summary: Explores how tokenization and blockchain-based infrastructure could reshape financial markets by improving efficiency, market access, and settlement processes, while highlighting the need for institutional readiness and supportive market structure.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/Industry/The Oracle Platform Powering Institutional Tokenization.pdf
title: The Oracle Platform Powering Institutional Tokenization
summary: Overview of an oracle platform positioned as core infrastructure for institutional tokenization, emphasizing secure offchain data connectivity, interoperability, and support for compliant digital asset workflows. It argues that reliable oracle networks are essential to scaling tokenized financial markets.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/Industry/Tokenization of Money Market Funds FOR INSTITUTIONAL - WHOLESALE - PROFESSIONAL.pdf
title: Tokenization of Money Market Funds FOR INSTITUTIONAL - WHOLESALE - PROFESSIONAL
summary: Analyzes how tokenized money market funds can serve institutional and wholesale investors by improving operational efficiency, liquidity access, and collateral mobility, while highlighting legal, regulatory, and market structure constraints to broader adoption.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/Industry/XRPL - Tokenization is No Longer a Theory (Dec 2025).pdf
title: XRPL - Tokenization is No Longer a Theory (Dec 2025)
summary: Argues that tokenization has moved from concept to practical deployment, with XRPL positioned as infrastructure for issuing and managing real-world and digital assets at scale. Emphasizes institutional use cases, market maturation, and operational benefits for asset markets.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/IOSCO/Financial Assets Tokenization .pdf
title: Financial Assets Tokenization
summary: Explores the tokenization of financial assets, outlining how distributed ledger technology can reshape issuance, trading, and post-trade processes while introducing regulatory, operational, and market integrity considerations. It highlights implications for market structure, investor protection, and cross-border supervisory coordination.

path: Tokenization_Blockchain_and_Digital_Assets/MAS_FCA_DeutscheBank_Schroder/MAS, FCA, Deutsche Bank, Schroder - Tokenized Funds.pdf
title: MAS, FCA, Deutsche Bank, Schroder - Tokenized Funds
summary: Explores how tokenized funds can modernize fund issuance, distribution, and servicing by improving efficiency, transparency, and interoperability, while highlighting the regulatory, operational, and market-structure conditions needed for broader institutional adoption.

summary: Guide to the key legal questions when applying distributed ledger technology to trade processes and documents.
